title: The First Encounter of the Twinborn
next_chapter_hook: Just as that voice was about to reveal more truths, a golden vertical eye suddenly opened in the void—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, ruthlessly cutting off this reunion spanning ten thousand years.

text.content: In the void beyond the ruins, a call carrying the resonance of fate pierced through the layers of forbidden formations, striking directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a sound emanating from the depths of his bloodline,，带着无法抗拒的蛊惑 (carrying an irresistible seduction). Chen Ji's body shuddered violently, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand suddenly scorching hot, emanating a strange golden-red glow, as if responding to some ancient summoning. He abruptly raised his head, his pupils contracting to dangerous pinpoints—this feeling was too familiar, familiar enough to make the long-healed wound at the deepest part of his heart ache. "Impossible..." he murmured, his Adam's apple rolling with difficulty, "In this world, besides her, no one should be able to trigger my blood resonance..."

The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment writhed like living creatures, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly shaking violently, the aged voice carrying a rare hint of terror: "This is... the resonance of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key?! Boy, what secrets are hidden in your body? This old man accompanied your ancestor Chen Xuan for thousands of years, yet never saw such a powerful bloodline imprint!" Chen Ji did not answer, his consciousness already pulled by that call, falling into a chaotic crimson void. All around was endless darkness, only a golden-red point of light at his chest kept pulsing, like another heart frantically knocking against the walls of fate.

In the depths of the void, a figure slowly took shape. Chen Ji's eyes widened—a woman in jet-black battle armor, surrounded by eerie blood-patterned markings, her silver hair cascading down to her waist like a waterfall. Her face was a world apart from the naive girl in his memories, her brows and eyes filled with an air of supremacy and vicissitudes that overlooked all beneath heaven. Yet those eyes—those pitch-black eyes identical to his own—now radiated an indescribably complex light. "Chen Ji..." she spoke, her voice hoarse yet carrying an uncontrollable tremor, "I have searched for you for thirteen thousand years." Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, his throat feeling as if gripped by something, and only after a long while did he挤出 (挤出) a few words: "Chen... Nian?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian smiled, that smile containing too many emotions Chen Ji could not comprehend—bitterness, relief, madness, and a twisted longing. "You still remember me." She stepped forward slowly, each step making the surrounding void tremble, "I thought that废物 (废物) father of yours had long erased all memories of me from you." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart.废物 father? Erase memories? There was more to this story! His face revealed nothing, merely watching this familiar yet strange woman, speaking calmly: "You seem to know many things I do not."

text.content: Chen Nian stopped three feet away from him, tilting her head to examine him, her gaze like inspecting a treasure recovered after being lost. "You really have changed." she softly said, "The old you would not have looked at me with these eyes—that calculation hidden beneath tranquility, even I was almost deceived." Chen Ji gave no comment, merely slightly sidestepping, nonchalantly tucking the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve. Upon seeing this, Chen Nian's smile deepened: "No need to be nervous, I won't take your things. On the contrary..." she raised her hand, golden-red light泛起 (emanating) from her fingertips, identical to the Tianji Record, "This thing was originally stripped from me."

This sentence landed like a heavy hammer on Chen Ji's heart. The Tianji Record was hers? He instinctively activated his Tianji power, yet discovered the golden sea in his Mental Sea churning violently, as if responding to some ancient call. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul said in horror: "Impossible! The Tianji Record was clearly the supreme treasure Chen Xuan obtained from the Heavenly Dao rift, how could it be related to a woman?" Chen Nian seemed unable to hear Mo Xiansheng's voice; she merely gazed at Chen Ji, a trace of recollection flashing in her eyes: "You know far too little. For instance... we are by no means ordinary siblings."

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Nian's earth-shattering revelation, Chen Ji chooses:

choices.description: Directly questioning Chen Nian about the secrets of the twinborn's identity and the Tianji Record's origins, displaying a thirst for truth.
choices.risk_hint: Potentially Letting the Opponent Exploit Psychological Weaknesses
choices.process_label: 你选择直接追问真相，展现出对情报的渴望。

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke, his voice so calm it was almost cold: "Since you know so much, then make it clear. What are we? Why is the Tianji Record on you? And—" he paused, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes, "Why have you become a commander of the Demonic Path?" Chen Nian was slightly stunned, then broke into a bright smile, that smile even carrying a childlike smugness: "I knew you would ask. You've always been like this since childhood—clearly anxious to the core, yet acting more composed than anyone."

dialogue.content: She stood with hands clasped behind her back, the blood-patterned markings around her flowing increasingly rapid: "When the Heavenly Dao first opened, a pair of Heavenly Fate Twinborn were born. One bore the power of prophecy, the other bore the responsibility of binding. We were born as pieces on Heaven's chessboard—until one day, our 'loving' father discovered this." Chen Ji's heart shook violently, yet his face remained motionless. Chen Nian continued: "He sealed the power of prophecy into the Tianji Record, refined the responsibility of binding into a lock key, and then... separated us. He wanted to use us, yet forbade us from knowing our own identity. You think you were a废物?" she冷笑 (sneered), "You were merely a artificially sealed vessel."

choices.description: Not easily trusting the other party, hinting it may be an enemy trap, responding with silence and observation.
choices.process_label: 你选择按兵不动，静观其变。

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely watching her silently, his gaze profound as an abyss. Chen Nian waited for several breaths, seeing no response from him, her brow gradually knitting: "Won't you ask anything?" Only then did Chen Ji speak calmly: "Ask what?" His tone was as if discussing today's weather, "You say you are Chen Nian, so you are? You say the Tianji Record is yours, so it is?" He slightly raised his chin, the corner of his mouth curling with mockery, "Why should I trust you?" Chen Nian's smile froze on her face, a trace of hurt flashing in her eyes, quickly hidden by her. "You really have... changed a lot."

dialogue.content: She took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing her emotions, her voice turning cold: "Fine, you want proof是吧?" She waved her hand, a beam of golden-red light shooting toward Chen Ji. Chen Ji下意识 (instinctively) wanted to dodge, yet discovered that light directly entered his chest—a surge of scalding power instantly erupted from his heart,疯狂 (madly) resonating with something within his body. Chen Ji groaned, falling to one knee, cold sweat dripping down his forehead. That feeling was too familiar, like when he first activated the Tianji Record, yet a hundred times stronger. "This is the Binding Resonance." Chen Nian looked down at him, "You and I were originally one—seals can isolate memories, yet cannot isolate blood."

choices.description: Not dwelling on identity issues, directly asking the other party's purpose in finding him, maintaining the initiative.
choices.process_label: 你选择将话题引向核心利益。

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Regardless of who you are, regardless of where the Tianji Record came from—I only have one question for you." He spoke each word deliberately, "You went through great lengths to find me—what do you want?" Chen Nian froze for a moment, then burst into laughter, her voice echoing through the empty Void with a mix of madness and sorrow: "Good! Good one, Chen Ji!" She wiped away the tears from her eyes, "You've finally learned to ask the right question." Her expression hardened, becoming unprecedentedly serious: "What I want is simple—to break the Heavenly Dao's chess game and destroy those arrogant manipulators."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow slightly: "Heavenly Dao?" Chen Nian sneered, and the blood-colored patterns around her suddenly blazed, sketching a massive golden vertical pupil pattern in the Void. "What do you think the Heavenly Dao is?" Her voice turned ice-cold, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that is the true Chess Player of this game. What we call fate is merely its amusement. It set us as chess pieces, yet forbade us from knowing each other. We've resisted for ten thousand years, but we've never escaped its grasp." She gazed at Chen Ji, her eyes burning with vengeful flames: "Until I discovered—as long as twin siblings join forces, we can briefly disrupt its perception."

text.content: Chen Ji's mind raced, the Tianji Record Fragment humming in his Mental Sea. He suddenly spoke: "Sharing the Shackles' power—what does that mean?" Upon hearing this, a flash of joy appeared in Chen Nian's eyes. She slowly raised both hands, the golden-red light from her fingertips resonating with the warmth in Chen Ji's chest. "Simple." She murmured, "The Shackles are responsible for sealing, while Prophecy is responsible for foresight—we were originally two sides of the same coin. If we join forces, the consumption of the Tianji Record can be halved, and the control brand carved by the Holy Sect on me... can be shared by you." Chen Ji's pupils contracted, finally showing a hint of emotion. Halving the Heavenly Fate consumption? This meant he could use the Heavenly Secrets power more frequently.

Chen Nian sensed his hesitation, a meaningful smile curving her lips: "You're worried I'm deceiving you?" She proactively extended her hand, palm facing up, "Come, try it and see." Chen Ji stared at that hand, his mind calculating rapidly. The Tianji Record had never been wrong—it had no warning about this woman, which in itself explained the situation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul also remained uncharacteristically silent, seemingly waiting for his decision. After a moment, Chen Ji raised his hand and lightly clasped hers. In an instant, a burning force surged through his palm, violently colliding with some dormant potential within him.

dialogue.content: Golden light erupted between the two, and Chen Ji felt the golden sea within his Mental Sea suddenly surge. The Tianji Record's runes疯狂游走，竟隐隐有合为一体的趋势。然而就在这时，陈念的脸色骤然惨白，一口鲜血喷涌而出。她的声音变得急促而惊惶："不好——它在监视我们！快断开连接！"话音未落，虚空深处骤然睁开一只金色的竖瞳，冰冷的目光穿透层层虚空，直直锁定两人。陈机心头剧震，一股无法抗拒的威压从那只竖瞳中倾泻而下，仿佛整个天地都在对他施以天罚。"卑微的棋子……"一个超越性的声音在虚空中回荡，"谁允许你们触碰禁忌？"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye suddenly intervened, Chen Ji's choice:

choices.description: Immediately sever the connection with Chen Nian, bearing the Heavenly Eye's backlash alone to protect her.
choices.risk_hint: May suffer serious injuries or even death
choices.process_label: 你决定独自承担一切后果。

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed with determination. He abruptly released Chen Nian's hand while condensing all the power in his Mental Sea into a barrier, sealing off the gaze of that golden vertical pupil. "Go!" He growled, his voice carrying undeniable authority. Chen Nian's eyes widened, disbelief written across her face: "Are you insane! You're exposing yourself to it—" Chen Ji didn't answer. He gritted his teeth, allowing that terrifying pressure to constantly crush his divine sense. The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment flickered frantically, each flicker draining a massive amount of Heavenly Fate from his body. Agonizing pain spread from the depths of his Mental Sea throughout his entire body, as if countless blades were simultaneously carving his soul.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's eyes suddenly reddened. Thirteen thousand years of waiting, searching, and resisting—all condensed into one heart-wrenching cry: "Chen Ji!!" Her figure gradually dissipated under the golden vertical pupil's pressure, yet she was still desperately reaching out, trying to grasp him. Chen Ji gazed at that face, somewhat similar to his own, and a faint smile actually appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Next time we meet... remember to bring a gift." Before the words finished, the last trace of Heavenly Fate within him burned out. The golden vertical pupil let out an angry shriek and suddenly closed. The Void collapsed, and Chen Ji's consciousness fell into endless darkness.

choices.description: Join forces with Chen Nian to resist the Heavenly Eye's oppression, displaying the true power of twin siblings working together.
choices.process_label: 你选择与陈念并肩作战。

text.content: Chen Ji didn't release Chen Nian's hand; instead, he gripped it even tighter. Golden-red light erupted from where their palms met, transforming into a brilliant pillar of light that shot directly toward that golden vertical pupil. "You want us to be chess pieces?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, his voice echoing through the Void, "Then I'll flip this chessboard!" Chen Nian froze for a moment, then burst into hearty laughter, her eyes filled with crazy light: "Good! That's the Chen Ji I know!" She grabbed Chen Ji's wrist with her other hand, pouring all her Shackles power into that pillar of light without reservation. The moment the two forces merged, an unprecedented power awakened within Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: A flash of astonishment appeared in the golden vertical pupil, then transformed into raging fury: "Two mere chess pieces, daring to challenge heavenly might?!" It abruptly opened wide, and a destructive force poured out from within. However, what shocked Chen Ji was—the force, upon approaching them, was actually deflected by the golden-red pillar of light. The Heavenly Eye roared in fury: "Impossible! The twin siblings have been separated for ten thousand years, their bloodline should have thinned—" Before it could finish, the Void suddenly collapsed. That golden vertical pupil was forcibly driven back, dissolving into countless golden fragments scattered in the darkness. Chen Nian collapsed weakly into Chen Ji's arms, smiling weakly: "Did you see... when we join forces, we can achieve..."

text.content: The Void completely collapsed, and Chen Ji's consciousness rapidly fell into endless darkness. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea emitted a weak hum, like a flickering lamp barely maintaining his last trace of consciousness. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out urgently: "Boy! Hold on! This old man will use his last bit of power to stabilize your Mental Sea—but listen carefully, you'll wake up at the entrance to the ruins. The Heavenly Eye may have retreated temporarily, but it has left a mark on you!" Chen Ji wanted to speak but discovered he had exhausted even that bit of strength. His consciousness grew hazier and hazier, faintly sensing a hand tightly gripping his wrist.

Scene shifts. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, and what entered his vision was a dazzling golden light—Su Qingyao's anxious face, staring at him from up close. Her eyes were slightly red, her voice carrying suppressed trembling: "Chen Ji! You're finally awake—do you know you were unconscious for three days and three nights?" Chen Ji tried to sit up but found his whole body aching and weak, as if all his energy had been drained. He struggled to lift the corner of his mouth: "Three days..." When Su Qingyao saw he still had the mood to speak, the knot in her heart relaxed slightly, yet she still kept a straight face: "You're still laughing! Do you know what nonsense you were spouting while unconscious? Something about 'Chen Nian,' something about 'Shackles'—what exactly did you experience?"

Chen Ji did not answer Su Qingyao's question; his gaze passed over her shoulder toward the sky beyond the window. The pressure from that golden vertical pupil three days ago remained vivid in his memory—the Heavenly Secrets Eye—that was the true Chess Player in this game. And Chen Nian... his sister, or rather, his other self, was now trapped in the tiger's den of the Demonic Path Holy Sect. They had found each other, yet were forced apart. When would they meet again? Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, silently vowing in his heart: 'Chen Nian, wait for me. This time, I'll be the one to save you.' His hand unconsciously clenched, nails deeply embedding into his palm, drawing a thread of blood.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao noticed his peculiarity, her brow furrowed tightly. She had never seen Chen Ji wear such an expression—not indifference, not calculation, but a determination bordering on stubbornness. 'Chen Ji,' she softly called, pressing her hand on his shoulder. 'Whatever you're facing, I'm not your enemy.' Chen Ji opened his eyes, meeting her gaze filled with concern, and felt an unexpected surge of complex emotions rising within him. This woman had repeatedly approached the truth, repeatedly had her efforts deflected by him—yet now she had become the most likely person to stand by his side. He calmly spoke, 'Senior Sister Su, do you truly want to know what I've encountered?'

choice.prompt: Confronted by Su Qingyao's pressing questions, Chen Ji chose:

choices.description: Reveal the encounter with a blood relative but conceal the Heavenly Secrets Eye and twin truths to protect Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_cost: It might involve her in greater danger
choices.process_label: 你选择对她坦诚部分真相。

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then spoke: 'I met my sister.' Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, her face filled with disbelief. Chen Ji continued, 'She has been trapped in the Demonic Path Holy Sect for many years, and this time, our blood resonance allowed us to briefly establish a connection.' He spoke casually, omitting the most critical information—the identity of the twins, the origins of the Tianji Record, and the threat of the Heavenly Secrets Eye. Su Qingyao stared at him intently, as if attempting to discern more from his expression. 'Is that all?' she asked. Chen Ji nodded. 'That's all.' His tone was calm, yet his eyes showed no evasion. 'She is my family, and I will never abandon her.'

Su Qingyao observed the subtle tenderness in his eyes, and a sudden wave of melancholy surged within her. She was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the favored daughter of the Tianqing Sect—when had she ever been so concerned about another person? Yet this man, once dismissed as worthless by her, now made her feel an unprecedented sense of helplessness. 'Very well,' she softly said. 'I won't probe further. But Chen Ji—' She reached out, her fingertip touching his Brow Center. 'I will help you investigate this mark on your body.' Chen Ji was slightly startled, then felt a warm Spiritual Energy flow from her fingertip into his Mental Sea, gently soothing the wounds scorched by the Heavenly Secrets Eye. He lowered his gaze and murmured, 'Thank you.'

choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, using injured and confused excuses to deflect Su Qingyao, avoiding any establishment of trust.

text.content: Chen Ji avoided Su Qingyao's gaze, presenting a weak and bewildered expression: 'I'm not quite sure either... it felt like a dream, all hazy.' He rubbed his Brow Center, feigning pain. 'After waking up, I don't remember anything at all.' Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even more deeply. She stared at Chen Ji for a long while, suspicion flickering in her eyes. This man had too many mysteries; every time she thought she was getting close to the truth, he would casually brush it aside. She suddenly reached out, gripping Chen Ji's chin, forcing him to meet her gaze. 'Chen Ji, do you think I'm a fool?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was startled by her gesture, then苦笑: 'Senior Sister Su, everything I said is true.' Su Qingyao stared into his eyes, speaking word by word: 'Then tell me, the name you called while unconscious—'Chen Nian'—who is that?' The air instantly froze. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, concealing the fleeting sharpness in his eyes. This woman was more difficult to deal with than he had imagined. He took a deep breath, speaking in a tone approaching weariness: 'She is my sister who disappeared many years ago. The rest... I truly don't remember.' Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while before finally releasing her grip. She stood up, her back to him, her voice cold: 'Chen Ji, I won't pressure you. But remember—your lies, I see through them.'

text.content: After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji lay alone on the bed, staring blankly at the ceiling. Deep within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment was slowly recovering its former radiance. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed: 'Boy, you've gone too far. The Heavenly Secrets Eye has taken notice of you; from now on, every step you take will be watched by it.' Chen Ji did not respond, but quietly sensed the nascent power within his body—the potential awakened during the blood resonance with Chen Nian. Though faint, it was real. Sharing shackle power... so this was the key to breaking the chess game. He closed his eyes and began mentally deducing every subsequent move.

Beyond the ruins, in the Void, a call carrying destiny's resonance pierced through the layered prohibitions, striking directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a voice from the depths of bloodline, carrying an irresistible temptation. Yet at this moment, within the deepest Forbidden Grounds of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, Chen Nian knelt on the ground. The bloodline patterns around her body pulsed frantically, forcibly suppressing the Heavenly Secrets Eye's backlash. She raised her head; her ink-black eyes burned with an unprecedented light: 'Chen Ji... wait for me.' She murmured, her lip corners curving into a bloodthirsty smile. 'This time, together—let's overturn this heaven.' She slowly rose to her feet. The demonic energy around her surged like a tide, coalescing behind her into a massive demonic shadow. The shadow's face bore a seven-point resemblance to Chen Ji.

At the same time, though the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure retreated, it left an inconspicuous golden mark on Chen Ji's Brow Center. This was the Heavenly Dao's marking of a chess piece; from now on, no matter where he was, he would be watched by that lofty eye. Yet Chen Ji showed no panic—his lip corners even curved into a meaningful smile. 'Being watched...' he murmured to himself, fingers gently stroking his Brow Center. 'Then so be it.' He slowly sat up, sensing the shared shackle power connecting him to Chen Nian within his body. It was an unprecedented sensation, as if a gap had been opened within fate's shackles, allowing a few threads of light to filter through. Mo Xiansheng was right; from now on, he would face greater danger. But he had the Tianji Record, had the Foresight Ability, and had a sister equally unwilling to be a chess piece. The chess game of fate had only just begun.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul remained silent for a long while before finally speaking: 'Boy, do you know why the Heavenly Secrets Eye wanted to sever your dialogue?' Chen Ji shook his head. Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'Because you touched the secret it least wanted anyone to know—the twins working together can disrupt Heavenly Secrets. What it fears is not you growing stronger, but you knowing the truth and no longer being willing to be chess pieces.' A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: 'So it severed the dialogue because it feared us knowing more?' Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment, then slowly said: 'Not only that. It... is afraid.' Chen Ji was stunned for an instant, then coldly laughed: 'Afraid? Then let it continue to be afraid.' He clenched his fist, sensing the bloodline resonance connecting him to Chen Nian within his body. 'This time, I will never let anyone manipulate my destiny.'

text.content: Just as that voice was about to reveal more truth, a golden vertical pupil suddenly opened in the Void—the Heavenly Secrets Eye's gaze, mercilessly severing this reunion spanning ten thousand years. The golden vertical pupil emitted destructive pressure, directly locking onto Chen Ji's location. A chilling killing intent pierced through the layered prohibitions, pressing against his chest like substantial force. Chen Ji groaned, his pupils reflecting that terrifying eye, yet an unyielding fire burned in his heart—how about the Heavenly Secrets Eye? The more it tried to prevent their alliance, the more it proved the correctness of this path. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, confronting that vertical pupil, his lip corners curving into a mocking smile: 'Do you see it?' he murmured. 'This is what it fears.' The Tianji Record Fragment hummed in his Mental Sea, as if responding to his determination.
